title: Fix the 'past 90d' repositories block showing the 180-day LOC
target_unit: addBigRepositoriesSummary() in LandscapeReportGenerator (file of 1,587 LOC, very high risk; the unit itself is about 40 LOC, below the unit threshold)
notes: A one-line fix (+1/-1): the 'past 90d' info block passed loc180Days as its LOC text (copy-paste from the 180d block) while its count and percentage used the 90-day figures; the reference diff applies to the snapshot as is. In variant B the block sits in LandscapeReportOverviewSection.addBigRepositoriesSummary (file of 318 LOC). The acceptance test builds a landscape with two repositories — 500 LOC with commits in the past 30/90/180 days, 2,000 LOC with commits only in the past 180 days — generates index.html into a @TempDir and reads the LOC figure of each info block (the text between the block's label and the first ' LOC' after it): 180d = 2.5K, 90d = 500, 30d = 500. Verification: A before = compiles, FAILS (past 90d: expected 500 but was 2.5K); A after (git show 90fa40b1 applied with patch -p1) = PASSES, reports module green (mvn -q -o -pl reports -am test); B before = compiles, FAILS the same way; B after (same line in LandscapeReportOverviewSection) = PASSES, reports module green.
